bio: Bethia Horton, a daughter of Bethia Wells, married Henry Tuthill, known as "the Justice". A family record printed in the Horton genealogy gives her death on 16 March 1744 "in the 73d year of her age", which places her birth about 1671, though another account gives about 1674; Henry died on 4 January 1750, aged 84. Through her mother she descends from William Wells, which makes her John's 1st cousin 10 times removed, and she was the great-grandmother of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison.

conflicts.found: c. 1674 (Akerly) vs c. 1671 (age at death in family record)
